```text
# PR #4341: Patch: the Created cards on /stats show only Tier and Adjusted, sorted and viewed as the deck cards are

Closes #4083

Built as the plan says. Ruling **R4083000** records it.

## What changed

**Server: `GET /api/stats/cards`** (`crates/server/src/api/stats.rs`)
- Each `created` row now sends only these 12 fields: `id`, `name`, `cost`, `rarity`, `set`, `games`, `hasEnoughGames`, `adjustedWinRate`, `adjustedLow`, `adjustedHigh`, `tier` and `window`.
- Removed: the `createdPlayed*` and `createdNotPlayed*` figures, their Radiant and normal splits, and `createdPlayedDelta`.
- `games` is now `stats.games()`, every seat that made a copy, used or not.
- `tiers.created`, the route, the totals and the store are unchanged, and there is no migration.
- `stats-cards`, `stats report` and `stats compare` still print the full Created table.
- Before removing the fields I grepped `apps/`, `e2e/` and `analysis/`. The only readers were the web files changed here.

**Web**
- **Columns** (`stats/CreatedPanel.tsx`): both sections (Tokens and Other created cards) show only Card, Name, Tier and Adjusted, with Games behind the Columns toggle. Win rate is gone.
- **Sort:** the panel no longer keeps its own sort. It takes the tab's sort, and a header press asks the tab to change it.
  - The Tokens tab uses the Cards tab's sort, so it stays in the address (`sort`, `dir`). Its select offers Name, Games, Tier and Adjusted.
  - Tier puts S first, then orders a tier's cards by tier fit (a card with no fit after), then by Adjusted.
  - `createdSortOf` turns a Cards-tab Win rate or Play rate sort into Adjusted, keeping its direction.
- **Grid:** each section gets its own grid (`tokensGrid`, `createdGrid`). A card shows its face or plain text, then its tier chip, Adjusted and games, and opening it opens the drill-down.
- **Show 95% ranges:** the Adjusted range shows under Adjusted and the tier fit under Tier, in the table and the grid, only from the floor.
- **Options row:** the Cards tab's row moved, unchanged, into `cardOptions(created)`, which the Tokens tab now uses too. On the Tokens tab its Columns group has no Play rate button.
- **Filters:** the keyword filter is on both tabs and now filters the Created cards too.
- **Range text:** `RangeText` and `TierFitText` moved to `stats/RangeText.tsx` so both tabs can use them.
- **Tier fit:** `cardTierFit` now takes a structural `TierFitCard`, so a Created row works.
- **Card detail's Statistics panel** (`CardStatsBlock.tsx`): a card no deck holds shows Games, Tier and Adjusted win rate only. A deck card keeps all five figures.
- **Removed:** `createdWinRate` and `faceRate`, which nothing calls any more.

**Spec**
- New: `spec/rulings/R4083000.md` and its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4083.md`.
- §9.11: the "Queries." and "Public statistics…" paragraphs are rewritten.
- R2089000, R2370000, R3184002, R3324002, R4082000, R4155000 and R4279001 each get "amended by R4083000" in the title and an `Amended by [[R4083000]]` line at the end.
- `crates/server/README.md`: the sentence on what `created` answers is updated.

## How I tested it
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::stats::`: 56 passed, including the new `r4083000_a_created_row_answers_only_the_fields_the_client_reads`.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server`: every binary ok (1899 passed, 1 ignored, in the main suite).
- The four touched web test files: 137 passed. The 15 R4083000-named tests ran and passed.
- `vitest run --project web --changed origin/main` with the harness's excludes: 319 files, 6288 passed, 7 skipped.
- These were all clean: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, eslint on the touched files, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: "2317 rulings, 5824 proofs, 72350 citations in 4590 files, 31700 links: ok".
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: "Internal".
- I did not run the whole-workspace cargo tests or the e2e specs; the harness and CI run those.

## Decisions the issue did not settle
All are recorded in R4083000; each rejected option is in brackets.
- **Shared sort:** the Tokens tab has no sort or address key of its own; it uses the Cards tab's. (A second sort would need its own keys and give one select two meanings.)
- **Missing columns:** a Win rate or Play rate sort shows as Adjusted on the Tokens tab, in the same direction. (The alternative was falling back to the default sort.)
- **Grid figures:** the grid shows Games, as the deck grid does. Win rate is left out, since it is the figure this issue removes.
- **Keyword list:** it stays the deck cards' keywords. (Token-only keywords would empty the Cards tab, which shares the filter.)
- **Ties** keep the server's order, as R3184002 already says.
- **Grid label:** each grid `<ul>` is labelled by its section's title. The deck grid has no label, but there are two grids here and they need telling apart.
- **R3185000** is not amended, since its panel text describes deck cards. R4082000, which covered tokens in the panel, is.
